Arch is a financial technology company that automates the management of private investments through standardized data, documents, and insights. The Software Engineer will help develop and scale core platform components, build application features and services, and support automation, product launches, and infrastructure growth.
Enterprise Software
Finance
FinTech
Financial Services
Growth Opportunities
H1B Sponsor Likely
Top Investors
Responsibilities
Working with cross-functional teams (product, design, operations, infrastructure) to build and improve application features
Contributing to both user-facing interfaces and backend services using modern frameworks and technologies
Helping develop reusable software components and APIs that connect front-end and back-end systems
Writing clean, efficient, and reliable code, and learning how to optimize for performance and scalability
Participating in code reviews and learning best practices from peers and senior engineers
Assisting in designing and implementing systems that are scalable and maintainable across the stack
Troubleshooting and fixing issues across front-end, APIs, and databases
Gaining experience working with multiple programming languages, frameworks, and databases
Taking responsibility for assigned tasks and features, developing an end-to-end understanding of how they work
Qualification
Programming
Data Structures
Algorithms
Object-Oriented Design
Front-End Development
Back-End Development
Data-Intensive Systems
Financial Technology
Required
You currently in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent field, and are graduating between December 2026 and August 2027
Have experience building and programming, through internships, class projects, or personal work
Have strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design
Have frontend or backend development experience, full-stack exposure is a plus
Have a track record of taking on projects and seeing them through, even in ambiguous or fast-moving settings
Communicate and collaborate well across both technical and non-technical people
Preferred
Have contributed to a personal project, open-source work, or something outside a classroom that shows how you actually build
Have exposure to the kind of problems we solve here: automation, data-heavy systems, or fintech
Enjoy debugging and troubleshooting complex systems, not just building new features
Benefits
Offers Equity
Strong Team - You’ll be backed by a strong team that consistently exceeds client expectations and ships new products quickly.
Your work is high impact - Being part of a small team means you have real responsibility and impact from day one. You'll be involved in discussions that drive the growth and direction of our platform from the very beginning.
Product Market Fit - We have strong product market fit, exceptionally low churn, and have grown mostly organically through word of mouth.
Team community and camaraderie - We have enormous trust in each other and always do what we can do to support one another. We're always ready to step in to help.
Great office: Our new home at 199 Water Street gives us a beautiful, energizing space to come together as a team, collaborate more easily, and keep building the next chapter of Arch.
Lunch is on Us - We’ll keep the team fueled with lunch in the office, whether you’re catching up with teammates, talking through an idea, or just taking a well-earned break.
